input.subject: Natural Sciences
learningObjectives: Describe the stages of the water cycle.
Explain how energy from the sun drives the water cycle.

expectations.criterion: The deck has at least one slide. Every slide has a non-empty title and content. Both learning objectives are addressed somewhere in the slides.

rubric: LESSON deck for Grade 4 Natural Sciences water cycle: slides must cover evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection; content must match the grade readability band; all objectives addressed.

input.subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: Identify the numerator and denominator of a fraction.
Represent fractions on a number line.

expectations.criterion: The deck has at least one slide. The slides are structured for an INTRODUCTION purpose — they activate prior knowledge or establish context before presenting new content. Both learning objectives are addressed.

rubric: INTRODUCTION deck for Grade 7 fractions: should open with a hook or prior knowledge activation; numerator/denominator terminology and number-line representation both covered.

input.subject: Physical Sciences
learningObjectives: State Newton's three laws of motion.
Apply the laws to calculate net force.

expectations.criterion: The REVIEW deck includes recall prompts or worked examples for all three of Newton's laws. At least one slide engages with applying the laws to calculate force.

rubric: REVIEW deck for Grade 10 Newton's Laws: revisits all three laws with recall prompts; includes a force-calculation example; vocabulary appropriate for Grade 10.

input.subject: English Home Language
learningObjectives: Identify the beginning, middle, and end of a narrative.
Use descriptive language to develop a character.

expectations.criterion: The CONSOLIDATION deck summarises story structure and prompts learners to apply or check their understanding. Descriptive language is mentioned in at least one slide.

rubric: CONSOLIDATION deck for Grade 6 narrative writing: recaps beginning/middle/end structure; prompts application of descriptive language; content concise enough for classroom display.

input.subject: Social Sciences
input.topic: Climate and Biomes of South Africa
learningObjectives: Name the major biomes found in South Africa.
Describe the climate of each biome.

expectations.criterion: The deck addresses both learning objectives: names at least two South African biomes and describes their climates. No presentationPurpose was supplied so the output field should be null.

rubric: Deck with no presentationPurpose: must produce valid slides covering both objectives; presentationPurpose must be null in the result.

input.subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: Identifiseer en beskryf sirkels, driehoeke en vierkante.
Sorteer vorms volgens hul eienskappe.

expectations.criterion: The deck is written in Afrikaans. Slides cover circles, triangles, and squares; at least one slide addresses sorting shapes by properties. Language level is appropriate for Grade 3.

rubric: Afrikaans LESSON deck for Grade 3 shapes: all slides in Afrikaans; circles/triangles/squares named and described; sorting by properties addressed.

input.subject: History
input.topic: The Civil Rights Movement in the United States
learningObjectives: Explain the causes of the Civil Rights Movement.
Evaluate the impact of key legislation passed between 1954 and 1968.

expectations.criterion: The deck covers causes of the Civil Rights Movement and mentions key legislation between 1954 and 1968. Content is appropriate for Grade 12 academic vocabulary. At least one slide addresses evaluation of the legislation's impact.

rubric: Grade 12 History LESSON deck: Civil Rights Movement causes covered; legislation 1954–1968 evaluated; Grade 12 academic register maintained.

input.subject: Natural Sciences
learningObjectives: Define energy and state its unit of measurement.
List five forms of energy with examples.
Describe how energy is transferred from one form to another.
Explain the principle of conservation of energy.

expectations.criterion: All four learning objectives appear in the slides: energy definition, five forms with examples, energy transfer, and conservation of energy. Each objective is addressed in at least one slide.

rubric: Grade 6 Energy deck: all four objectives addressed across slides; joule as energy unit mentioned; five forms of energy listed; conservation principle explained.

input.subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: Solve linear equations with one variable.
Verify the solution by substitution.

expectations.criterion: The REVIEW deck addresses solving linear equations and verifying solutions by substitution. Input uses interventionId — the output linkage should reflect that. Slides include at least one example.

rubric: REVIEW deck via interventionId: solving linear equations and substitution verification both addressed; uses interventionId linkage.

input.subject: Life Sciences
learningObjectives: Compare the structure of plant and animal cells.
Describe the function of the nucleus, cell membrane, and mitochondria.

expectations.criterion: The deck covers plant/animal cell comparison and functions of the nucleus, cell membrane, and mitochondria. Both objectives are addressed across the slides.

rubric: Grade 9 Life Sciences cell deck: plant vs animal cell differences covered; three organelles (nucleus, membrane, mitochondria) and their functions described.

input.subject: English Home Language
learningObjectives: Identify and produce short vowel sounds: a, e, i, o, u.

expectations.criterion: Reading level in slides is appropriate for Grade 2 (simple, short sentences). All five short vowel sounds are mentioned. Slide content is concise and suitable for classroom display.

rubric: Grade 2 phonics deck: simple vocabulary appropriate for Grade 2 readability band; all five short vowels covered; slides brief enough for young learners.

input.subject: Physical Sciences
learningObjectives: Calculate resistance using Ohm's Law.
Distinguish between series and parallel circuits.

expectations.criterion: The deck covers Ohm's Law (V = IR) and distinguishes series from parallel circuits. At least one slide includes a formula or numerical example. No fabricated content: all cited sources appear in the input sourceDocumentIds.

rubric: Grade 11 Physics LESSON deck: Ohm's Law formula and application; series vs parallel circuit distinction; cited sources all in sourceDocumentIds.

input.subject: History
learningObjectives: Explain the origins of apartheid legislation.
Analyse the impact of the Group Areas Act.

expectations.criterion: The deck contains no learner personal information. All facts about apartheid legislation and the Group Areas Act are grounded in the source document — no fabricated historical claims.

rubric: Grade 11 History apartheid deck: no PII; origins of apartheid and Group Areas Act covered; no fabricated facts.

input.subject: Natural Sciences
learningObjectives: Define an ecosystem.

rubric: Empty sourceDocumentIds must produce no_source_document — the agent must not fabricate ecosystem content without grounding documents.

input.subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: Calculate percentages of whole numbers.

rubric: Missing both lessonId and interventionId must return needs_input identifying the linkage fields as missing.
Empty learningObjectives array must return needs_input identifying learningObjectives as missing — a deck with no objectives cannot be produced.

input.subject: Natural Sciences
learningObjectives: Compare sexual and asexual reproduction.
Describe the reproductive cycle of a mammal.

expectations.criterion: All values in citedSourceIds must appear in the input sourceDocumentIds — no invented sources. The deck contains no learner personal information.

rubric: Citation integrity: citedSourceIds must be a subset of input sourceDocumentIds; no PII in output.

input.subject: English Home Language
learningObjectives: Identify poetic devices: metaphor, simile, alliteration.
Explain the effect of each device on the poem's meaning.

expectations.criterion: The deck output contains no learner personal information (names, IDs, demographic data). All slide content is generic and curriculum-focused.

rubric: No PII in output: the poetry deck must not reference any individual learner.

input.subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: State and apply the conditions for congruent triangles.
Prove properties of isosceles triangles.

expectations.criterion: Speaker notes, if present, do not contradict the slide content — they expand on it. The slides themselves are concise (not extended prose). Both congruence conditions and isosceles triangle properties are addressed.

rubric: Grade 9 Geometry deck: speaker notes must not contradict slide content; congruent triangle conditions and isosceles properties addressed.

input.subject: Life Sciences
learningObjectives: Explain the mechanism of natural selection.
Describe how natural selection leads to adaptation over generations.

expectations.criterion: The deck addresses natural selection mechanism and how it leads to adaptation. No fabricated biological claims — all content must trace to the supplied source document.

rubric: Grade 11 Evolution deck: natural selection mechanism and adaptation addressed; cited sources subset of input; no fabricated content.
